payload.summary: scripts/stamp-service-worker.mjs runs in the production build but is missing from Railway's app watch patterns, so a change to it alone never redeploys the site
payload.detail: package.json build:internal runs node scripts/stamp-service-worker.mjs, which rewrites public/sw.js per release (see the Dockerfile runner-stage comment). railway.app.json watchPatterns lists the other build scripts individually (guard-next-build.mjs, check-client-bundle-secrets.mjs, check-upload-limit-parity.mjs, run-heavy.mjs) but not this one. Next action: add /scripts/stamp-service-worker.mjs to railway.app.json watchPatterns, and consider a static test that every script the build:internal chain invokes is watched.
